nom: The Ordinary GF 15% Serum for Visible Skin Repair and Wrinkles

avis.texte: I consistently used this every night, and used 2 bottles completely. It didn't reduce fine lines, plump skin, or soften deeper lines. Reviews were so good, I kept using it because I have mature skin. I've been done with it for a few months and my skin hasn't gotten worse. Feel fairly certain it had no effect.

I liked the feel of the product and I used it for a week and my skin became very dry and flaky. I don't think it is a bad product but it just wasn't right for my skin. I switched to the Hyaluronic Acid and had much better results.
Bought a bottle. 3 weeks in using it and I went and bought 2 more bottles. Using it in the morning before sunscreen then at night before bed.
I've been using this serum consistently as part of my daily facial routine. Overall my skin is smoother and with less fine lines

avis.titre: I love the Serum! Its really working!!!
avis.texte: I bought this at Ulta and I'm so glad I did. It really helps with wrinkles without being too heavy or greasy. My skin looks healthy and repaired. Highly recommend!

I'm super picky about the texture of products and hate when something is overly sticky. I was expecting this to be another let down,however, this serum has been my favorite skincare purchase! I saw results within the same week and I can definitely say I'll be repurchasing !
Workhorse that's comfortable, effective, affordable and fits easily in my routine. I've bought multiple bottles!

I really like this serum. It plays well with all all of my lotions and potions - and there are a lot. It makes my skin happy and it feels very healing. I'm allergic to some bug in my yard and the bites are terrible - they turn purple or black. I used it on one I have right now, and by the next morning it had stopped itching and the bump was reduced.
I have been using this serum for a while now and it's made my skin look smoother and vibrant.

I don't know what magic is in this product, but together with Vitamin C, it makes my skin so toned and brighter. I stopped using it for a bit and noticed the difference. I even get compliments and I get asked what I'm using on my face.
I've been using this serum for a few weeks and I'm starting to see some difference, and reduction of dark spots. It goes on easy and absorbs quickly.

Im 36 and ive recenly been noticing my extremely deep nasolabial folds. Ive been using this product for about a month now and i didnt think it was doing anything til i saw a pic i took a few months ago and compared it to a recent photo. Huge difference!!! I will always repurchase this product.

avis.titre: This will become a staple in my regimen
avis.texte: I had some fine lines which I wanted to treat. This worked within 2 weeks on those fine lines and also on deeper lines! Great product.

This is the first thing that I apply to my face after I cleanse. I started using it in January of 2025 and it has become a "must have" in my daily skin routine. I followup with other products from The Ordinary. This most definitely visibly reduces fine lines and wrinkles. The Ordinary products are mot only effective, they are extremely affordable.

I recently started getting back in to taking care if my skin. Im very picky with how certain products feel/dry on my skin and i wasnt expetcing my much but wooow! This serum impressed me so much. I will definitley be repurchasing as soon as i finish this up!

I've been purchasing since its release. This is probably my 5th bottle. If i stop using, i can always tell a difference in my skin. Helps with everything: texture, tone, acne, discoloration, lines, etc. Very lightweight yet hydrating.
This technology used to only be available at a high price point, and now it costs as much as a fast food combo thanks to The Ordinary.

This serum will stay in my routine. I am 42 and I use it on my entire face and neck. However, I'm focusing my attention on improvements of the lines on my forehead, neck and around my eyes. So far, they've improved slightly. I'm looking forward to seeing more improvement as I continue using it. I use it twice a day- every day along with other ingredients in my daily routines like aha and retinaldehyde serums.

This is my 2nd bottle of this serum, but not my last. This serum boasts that it is an "age support serum to help minimize and repair visible skin damage"….and it does. I use it daily with my other The Ordinary products, and I do see improvement in my skin texture. The fine lines are considerably less noticeable, and the dark spots are clearly much lighter. I love The Ordinary products not only for their results, but for their affordability as well.

Really helped even my skin tone. I used to wear makeup all the time, I feel more comfortable going without now. Skin is clearer, softer. I can also feel the tightening after I put it on. I notice less wrinkles and more even skin, and clearer complexion. Happy with the results.

I purchased this previously and had the same complaint that I have with all The Ordinary products. The packaging is not tamper resistant or tamper proof. The company needs to add a clear label dot or something that can help deter people from browsing in store and opening / testing products. It's a sanitation thing. Other than that - great product - I ordered it once a few months ago and within just 2 weeks of use, I had strangers actually comment on how good my skin looked.
I am pleasantly surprised how adding this to my skin regimen has brought back my flawless plump skin I had in my early 20s. I'm 34. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Effective and Part of my daily routine
avis.texte: I enjoy many of The Ordinary products . This really makes my skin glow and I can see small differences around my eyes especially. I use it morning and night and I am on my second bottle with back up already .
I love this product! It worked wonders for me! I am always pleased with The Ordinary brand!

I have aging skin so I like to try skincare. I like The Ordinary products im general. I bought this to add in with my normal routine. After using the entire bottle I can confidently say the fine lines on my forehead are barely noticeable. I will keep buying product. It doesnt bother my dry skin either. Great inexpensive product.

avis.titre: Makes my skin oily and breaks me out
avis.texte: I'm on my second bottle, I really like this product. My skin feels smoother and looks brighter. However, it makes my skin very oily throughout the day and I end up breaking out.

I'm 52. Some lines are past fixing. Others, if this is going to work, it should be able to soften them. I completed 1 bottle after consistent nightly use. It didn't cause me any breakouts, like some. My skin looks healthier, but I can't say I see a difference in fine lines. I'm trying 1 more bottle, and then I'll decide for sure.
I definitely noticed a difference after several weeks and have received compliments on my glowing complexion. I bought some for my friends and they also noticed a difference.

avis.titre: Meh it's ok may take longer than 10 weeks to show results
avis.texte: I don't care for the packaging, wish it was in an airless pump or even spray bottle type delivery method but I get that the dropper is the ordinary's aesthetic. I did a 13 week trial experiment on myself for this product, 3 bottles used. Results; I noticed a very slight softening of my forehead lines around 10 weeks then plateaued there. The product felt nice on the skin but it's a pain to incorporate so much of it into my routine for not a lot of results, think I'll try something else now but was worth a shot. Your mileage may vary, good luck.
I agree with the earlier reviewer who mentioned forehead texture. I experienced the same thing, and I don't normally breakout on my forehead.

This genuinely truly is one of their best products. I've been using this for about 3 months now and have had great results. Im 48, and started taking my skincare more seriously in the last 5 years, so my skins not terrible but seeing small signs of aging. This made my fine lines and wrinkles definitely softer, skin texture feels more dense or springy, and I've had several people say my skin looks great and "I just have a glow" I would highly recommend! I work in a med spa with a medical provider and recommend this almost daily over medical grade products.

I have been using this almost daily, morning and night. I had a couple of dark marks on my neck and they are slowly going away. My face and neck looks smoother. The consistency is watery, but it absorbs fast. Not bad for the price.

I wanted so badly to have amazing results with this product - so many raving reviews!! Unfortunately, the only difference this made for my skin is new texture on my forehead - those little under the skin bumps you can't extract. I was dedicated and tried the whole bottle which took a little over one month, hoping the texture would subside or my skin would adjust or these amazing benefits everyone was raving about were just around the corner, but nope, just texture :/ I'm hoping it will clear up okay now that I've finished the bottle and will NOT be repurchasing.

i used this product for over a month with no issues and was definitely seeing some results UNTIL… one morning i woke up with my eyes swollen, itchy, scabbed over, red. it was so painful and lasted weeks since i didnt realize it was this product, i had been using it for almost two months. it has taken awhile for my skin to recover. do not recommend

I am not saying it's the holy grail for wrinkles but it definitely smooths them. Easily absorbed, not greasy, affordable, I trust the brand, compatible with other of their products, I do recommend it.

My 3rd bottle, one bottle lasts me one month. I use it along with the Matryxl & it's helped! lines are smother, dark spots are fading. The growth factors are plant-based, and I've never used other types that are more expensive. But this stuff works!

I'm a 46 year old female who does not have a regular skin care routine, but within the last 6 months I have noticed a saggy jaw line. I've been using this product for 2 weeks now and it has visibly reduced the appearance of the wrinkly skin under my jaw. I only use it under my jaw and I use my normal moisturizer after. Thank you sooooo much to the employee who recommended this to me. You have no idea how grateful I am! 💗💗💗

I'm in my 40's and have been using this once daily for three weeks. My results have been astonishing. The saggy marionette lines that were making me look both old and grumpy are almost gone. The finer wrinkles on my forehead and the corners of my eyes have all but vanished. Overall my skin looks firmer and brighter. As others have mentioned it's quite thin but I see that as a positive, it goes on very light and absorbs quickly. I'm surprised something that works this well is so affordable. This is a great product for aging skin!

I was super skeptical about this when it came out. I even watched several YouTube videos by dermatologists that I trust. They didn't believe that this would give results. However, I love a lot of products from The Ordinary, so I tried it anyway. I just bought my second bottle! I'm 47 with texture and some fine lines. This seems to make my skin glow. I can't say that it does specific things, but my skin just looks better overall.

I have been using this for over a week and see a small difference already around and between my eyes and my forehead. I use it morning and night. At night, I use it before the Retinol. I am very pleased with it so far and will continue to use it.

One of these bottles lasts me less than one month, as I use it twice/day on my face, hands, and neck. So far, it's broken up dynamic wrinkles and fine lines, made a sore on my upper lip heal after nothing else worked, and evened some skin tone.

avis.titre: I like it more than I expected
avis.texte: This feels like water, but my 52 year old skin looks better after I've put it on. I will likely keep using it.

There are many problem products from the ordinary that I like, and maybe one other that I actually love. This product leaves them all behind. I have never seen such an extraordinary fast change with the possible exception of the SRGG lactic acid treatment. But this is more than just simple exfoliation. More than any other product I've used, it seems to turn back the hands of time, adding glow, reducing dryness, and softening wrinkles. And it feels like nothing! I cannot recommend it enough. I have literally bought this or recommended it to almost every woman I know. My only caveat is this is not for the young. Don't buy this if you're 20 thinking it will be helpful. You are already glowy and young. This is for women who have wrinkles and have lost that glow. You'll truly see success if you are of a certain age.

I'm still trying this. The consistency is very watery. I can't say if it's doing anything yet. I layer it with the Ordinary hyaluronic serum, then my moisturizer . I'm hoping for the best, but the jury is still out.
I use this in the morning before sunscreen and moisturizer. I feel like I've noticed a difference!
I've mowed through one bottle of this and my skin is smoother, some dark spots have gone away, and parts of my dynamic wrinkles are breaking up! I'm excited to see what else it will do

This is a must Buy!! Can't beat the price point for such an amazing product. It has removed all fine lines around my eyes, removed all sagging skin from my jowls, dramtically decreased the deepening lines from lips to jowl, not to metion how it has turned back time on my wrinkled hands. I've read reviews where people have complained about the watery consistency. This does not bother me. It only serves as a reminder that your thinnestw products go on first. So first your toner, the the GF solution. Here's to looking more Beautiful Ladies!

This is a must Buy!! Can't beat the price point for such an amazing product. It has removed all fine lines around my eyes, removed all sagging skin from my jowls, dramtically decreased the deepening lines from lips to jowl, not to metion how it has turned back time on my wrinkled hands. I've read reviews where people have complained about the watery consistency. This does not bother me. It only serves as a reminder that your thinnestw products go on first. So first your toner, the the GF solution. Here's to looking more Beautiful Ladies!

avis.titre: Haven't been using it for that long but..
avis.texte: This product manages to keep my acne at bay and it makes my skin feel super soft, I haven't seen huge changes in fine lines just yet, But Im hopeful/have been impressed with this product so far!
I like to use this after cleansing in the morning. It's so weightless and light on my face and my tinted moisturizer on top protects me from the South Florida sun.

I noticed a difference with first use and it's just getting better as time goes on. I was skeptical. For me, it makes my skin look healthy and plump. It goes wonderfully under makeup. I'm actually quite surprised at how much of a difference I see.

I'm 57 with decent skin overall. My aging and sun damage is mainly marionnette lines and fine lines on my upper lip. After a week of daily use in the morning there was a definite improvement in those lines. After a month it's a holy grail.

avis.titre: Yes I am going to be buying it again
avis.texte: It is probably not a total wrinkle cure but it seems to have diminished them especially on my jaw and corners of the eyes. It absorbs easily,not greasy at all, budget friendly,so it seems to be working.

avis.titre: I would buy the product again
avis.texte: I have been using this for about 2 weeks and have noticed a nice glow and tightening of my skin.

I'm a few weeks into my first bottle and my dynamic wrinkles have broken up, fine lines are disappearing, and my face looks brighter! I'm very impressed with these plant/based growth factors in such a short amount of time!

I have been using this serum daily for about little over a week now. Very lightweight and absorbs quickly. Pairs well with other ordinary products. No huge results just yet, but hasn't been very long. I have noticed my 11 lines are a tad softer.

What a fantastic serum this is. I've been using it a little over two weeks and my skin just drinks this up! The water based formula sinks right and leaves my skin so hydrated. I appreciate the price point for such an innovative formula with impressive ingredients. I think it's too soon to see results, however I love the way my skin feels with it and how it layers with my other skincare. I would certainly continue using as I have high hopes of its effectiveness. Gifted by theordinary

Growth Factors 15% Solution was gifted by Ordinary to me and I am so happy to have received this product. It is Amazing!! I love the fact it hydrates instantly. I have been using this product only for a week so have yet to see long term benefits but I already love how it feels on my skin

This product was a complimentary from the ordinary. I'm 30+ and I'm starting to see some wrinkles and aging on my face.. I've been trying this product for a while now and I really like how it makes my skin look and feel. My wrinkles look very less than how it used to be. I'm so happy.

I received this product gifted by the Ordinary. I like this Growth Factors serum. It made my skin feel nourished and less dry. I like that it doesn't have a strong scent and it absorbs well into the skin. I'm looking forward to seeing what it does with longer use

ABSOLUTELY AMAZING! No questions this is the best the ordinary product I have ever used. My face feels fantastic! I have been using it for a few weeks and I have noticed HUGE visible differences. So good!! Gifted by theordinary

As someone with seborrheic dermatitis, it can be hard to find products that don't feed malessazia. So I was excited to see that this product is FA safe. That's one thing I love about the Ordinary, the products have what you need but not what you don't. I was still a little hesitant to try this though because in the past growth factors irritated my skin. However, I haven't experienced any sensitivity with this product. I am glad this was gifted by theOrdinary I can't wait to report back with results.

I love the ordinary! This brand is not only affordable but works on my skin so well! I could notice the finer lines around my eyes diminishing over the time that I used this. It's affordable and I would recommend it. This was gifted by the ordinary.

It's a very subtle product almost watery. I noticed brightness on my skin. I use this product on my face and neck. My neck felt instantly like tight skin. It's working good so far. My forhead has some lines and it is also helping. gifted by the ordinary

I got this serum as a gift complimentary from The Ordinary. I love how it works with my damaged skin. It refreshes my skin and I am in my 30s and anti-aging for skin means the world to me. This one is one of the best serums I used this year. It hydrates my skin and makes my skin feel refreshed. I absolutely love the results.

Complimentary from TheOrdinary - thank you! After a few weeks of using, so far so good! I would say to start slow and use a small amount to test. I make sure to lather with a hydrating moisturizer after.

This product is wonderful I could not expect less from this brand that for its low cost is very good ingredients that fulfill what they promise. I've been using it for a week and my skin has left it super beautiful, luminous, clean and healthy. I love it

I received this serum complimentary from The Ordinary and have been using it for the last 2 weeks after cleansing and before moisturizing. It's very light weight, almost the consistency of water, which allows it to apply smoothly and absorb quickly into the skin. It's pretty odorless, or rather smells like any generic "unscented" or "fragrance free" lotion. Unfortunately, I found that it left my face feeling dry and actually looking a little dull. I occasionally have dry spots around my nose during winter months and that issue is more pronounced when using this serum. I didn't have any irritation, or breakouts after adding this product to my routine, but I also didn't notice any improvements. It's possible that a longer trial period is necessary.

Gifted by theordinary. This serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly. It adds hydration and makes my skin feel smooth, but I haven't noticed dramatic changes yet. It's a nice addition to my routine, and I'm excited to see if the results improve with continued use.

After two weeks of consistently using GF 15%, my skin is brighter and smoother! My skin did take a few nights to get used to the serum but by the end of the first week I noticed my skin starting to look more supple in the morning and not as dull. I'm happy with this serum! Gifted by theordinary 💗

Gifted by The Ordinary I have been testing the new Growth Factor Serum for a couple of weeks now and so far I have see great results. It's a thin serum that absorbs quickly and doesn't irritate my skin. So far, I am loving it!

Gifted by The Ordinary. This serum is lightweight and has a watery texture. It absorbs very quickly into my skin leaving it nicely hydrated. I've been using this for the past few weeks and have noticed an overall improvement in the look of my skin. It's still too early to see ant wrinkle improvements, but I'm eager to see what this does after a few more weeks.

Gifted by The Ordinary. This serum is lightweight and has a watery texture. It absorbs very quickly into my skin leaving it nicely hydrated. I've been using this for the past few weeks and have noticed an overall improvement in the look of my skin. It's still too early to see ant wrinkle improvements, but I'm eager to see what this does after a few more weeks.

avis.titre: My new routine staple to help repair skin damage
avis.texte: I love this product! The consistency is so smooth, not sticky, perfect for after my cleanser. I got this to help repair skin damage, I've only tried it for 2 weeks but so far I'm impressed! I will continue to use this product in my skincare routine. Gifted by the ordinary

avis.titre: Powerful Anti-Aging Serum for Radiant, Firm Skin!
avis.texte: I'm truly impressed with this serum gifted by theordinary! It provides instant hydration and radiance while visibly reducing fine lines and improving skin firmness in just weeks. The lightweight formula absorbs beautifully, leaving skin plumper and more resilient. With powerful plant-based growth factors, it's a must-try for anyone looking to restore a youthful, lifted glow!

I was recently gifted by theordinary, The Ordinary's Growth Factors 15%Solution and have been using it over the past two weeks or so. I love how fresh my skin looks, it has brightened and evened out my skin tone and I my skin is starting to look and feel a bit Firmer. I don't want to brag too much but I think my skin looks younger than before using the Growth Factors Solution. I am going to keep buying this on a regular basis.

This product is ok, but personally, didn't do so much for my skin. I have combo oily skin that's not sensitive — always looking to hydrate, brighten and firm skin.This product was liquidy and felt kind of sticky when you put it on and after 10 days, I haven't seen any many changes. Maybe I need to try it for longer. This was gifted to me by The Ordinary.

Complimentary from theordinary The Ordinary GF 15% Solution is an impressive serum designed to target skin regeneration and promote a more youthful appearance. With a 15% concentration of growth factors, it works to stimulate collagen production and improve skin texture. The formula is lightweight and absorbs easily, leaving the skin feeling smooth without any greasy residue. While results can take some time to show, consistent use may lead to visibly firmer, plumper skin. For those seeking an affordable option for anti-aging and skin rejuvenation, this product offers great value. However, sensitive skin types may want to patch-test first, as growth factors can be potent for some individuals.

The Ordinary gifted me their new growth factor serum and after using for a few weeks I am really pleased with it. I definitely feel like it smooths my skin out, softening fine lines and texture. It seems similar to much pricier serums I have used. The only thing I don't get from this serum is the hydration aspect, I amp up my moisturizer when using this. Definitely an incredible value for something so effective though.

This serum is fantastic, I love how it makes my skin look more fresh and glides on so smoothly! It is really great quality and I highly recommend! I also really like the brand the ordinary!! Try it out! Gifted by theordinary

If you are looking good to reverse the signs of aging, this serum is your dream come true. Its an age support serum containing 15% growth factor to help transform skin. Specifically it minimizes and repair visible damage in as little as 2 weeks. As amazing as that is, there's more. Thos serum also reduces the look of fine lines and wrinkles, firms, promotes skin elasticity, provides instant, all day hydration, brightens and help to support a stronger skin barrier. All this in one little bottle! I love what this serum has done for my skin. It looks so much more youthful, healthier and radiant. This is definitely a skincare must have! Gifted by The Ordinary

Complimentary from theordinary. I had been wanting to try EGF in my skincare after reading so many great things about it. It use in my night skincare routine. Its totally worth every penny after a nice facial treatment and this definitely helps soothe and heal fast definitely will continue to purchase

Gifted by theordinary. This is such a great texture and soaks into the skin really well. I like the results so far, but I think it will take a while to see full results for wrinkles. I haven't noticed any issues even though my skin has been super dry from it being winter.

* Gifted by theordinary I've been using this product for about two weeks now and have enjoyed it so far. My skin looks and feels more plump and softer. I haven't seen any noticeable changes in my smile lines so far but will definitely keep using to see if anything changes.

After receiving this complimentary from The Ordinary I can say that I would definitely purchase this product again. This help to change the overall texture and look of my skin. It is not drying and works perfectly under moisturizer. I highly recommend all to go out and try this product.

Fell in love with this product and notice a significant difference. It was gifted by theordinary. Used for two weeks for an honest review. It was very lightweight and can be combined with daily skincare rigimine. Used once a day

Gifted by Ordinary. The serum possesses a watery texture, resembling that of a toner, which allows for effortless application onto the skin. It delivers immediate hydration upon being applied to cleansed skin. The lightweight texture facilitates rapid absorption. It is noteworthy that the serum contains three growth factors, effectively addressing multiple signs of aging and skin damage concerns. Although it is too early to observe visible results, my skin feels the benefits of its action.

avis.titre: Permanent staple in my skincare routine
avis.texte: As someone with mature, dry skin, I'm always looking for effective, science-backed anti-aging solutions. This has a watery lightweight texture and absorbs nicely into my skin without leaving a heavy or sticky residue which makes it easy and enjoyable to apply. I did not see an immediate difference but noticed more when I consistently layered it with other The Ordinary skincare products. After a few weeks, I saw that my skin felt more hydrated, had better skin elasticity, and boosted my skin barrier. I love how affordable it is and look forward to seeing more results applying this long-term. Gifted by The Ordinary for my honest review.

the ordinary has always been a brand i go to when i want effective skincare without the hefty price tag. and this GF serum did not disappoint. it's like water with a bit more viscosity. very light but it does leave a tackiness that initially i was worried would pill, but it ended up layering very well with the rest of my skincare without pilling at all. i noticed my skin really enjoys this and i am excited to continue using it! this was kindly gifted by the ordinary

I've been using this for a week now, and I'm already seeing a difference! My skin feels smoother and looks a bit more refreshed—like I actually got a full night's sleep for once. It's super lightweight and absorbs quickly (I hate sticky serums). Too soon to say if it's doing anything major for fine lines, but my skin definitely looks healthier and more hydrated. Excited to see what happens with continued use! Gifted by TheOrdinary

I was gifted by the ordinary and I love their products! It's affordable and it works. I tried this out to help plump my skin and I see a slight difference with my acne scars. I like how it's not heavy on the skin.

Lightweight, fast-absorbing serum! Noticeable boost in skin hydration and texture. Skin feels plumper and smoother after a few weeks. Gentle, non-sticky formula — perfect for sensitive skin. Great addition to my routine for a healthy glow! complimentary from theordinary

*Gifted by theordinary* Really impressed with this one! Super lightweight and absorbs fast, leaving my skin feeling smooth and hydrated. Noticed a nice glow and plumper look after a few uses. Excited to keep using it and see more results—definitely worth trying!

I love how this had soften the look of my skin! I feel as tho it has made a difference in the week that I have been using this product! Although it was gifted by the ordinary, I would 10/10 recommend this product and would repurchase with my own money!

complimentary from theordinary I've been using this serum for a couple of weeks now, and I'm obsessed! It delivers deep hydration without feeling sticky or tacky—just smooth, nourished skin. It's become a staple in my nighttime routine, and I love that it's packed with growth factors to support my skin's renewal. This one's definitely a keeper!

avis.titre: I saw a difference almost immediately
avis.texte: I got this complimentary from the ordinary and I loved it, I've used it about a week now but I feel like after the first use my skin looked better hydrated and less tired, I also liked that it dried quickly and I was able to move faster through my skincare routine. I will definitely make this a regular part of my routine now.

avis.titre: My mom and i loves the formula!
avis.texte: this formula from the ordinary is superb! Love that its lightweight and my skin easily absorbs the product well. I instantly grabbed it on the shelf and tried it out it was amazing and my mom also loved it too! Gifted by theordinary

This product was Gifted by theordinary and I'm so thankful it was! It was so amazing to be able to try this product! I have a very uneven texture and really need extra hydration and I feel like after a week of using I saw a smoother complexion and less flaky skin. I didn't see as much change in wrinkles but over time that may change. It really has made my skin feel more hydrated and my makeup application a lot smoother!

avis.titre: Great addition to my skincare routine!
avis.texte: The Ordinary GF 15% Serum absorbs easily on my skin. Is has a runny like watery consistency which i enjoyed. I have a combination skin that leans more on the dry side; since i started using this serum my skin feels smoother, plump and hydrated. My skin looks healthier definitely worth the try. I'm going to use this as an aging skin prevention serum. Gifted by theordinary

avis.titre: Great addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: The Ordinary GF 15% Serum absorbs easily on my skin. Is has a runny like watery consistency which i enjoyed. I have a combination skin that leans more on the dry side; since i started using this serum my skin feels smoother, plump and hydrated. My skin looks healthier definitely worth the try. I'm going to use this as an aging skin prevention serum. Gifted by theordinary
Terrible. Broke me out and caused lots if redness and peeling.

Gifted by the Ordinary. Super pleased with this product! I noticed the help with texture first. My skin felt smoother and softer. After a few days I noticed a more subtle look for my skin. This is a great serum to add to your regimen if you are looking to help fine lines and texture.

This was gifted by theordinary. I was impressed by this product from the brand. It's super light weight. I like how it feels on when I apply it and also love the results I am seeing on my skin. I have seen a big difference on the elasticity of my skin specially on the jawline. I have seen an overall difference in the appearance of my skin.

Gifted by theordinary, I originally wanted to try this age-support serum for my feet—yes, my feet! It's designed to minimize and repair visible skin damage while helping regenerate aging skin, so I figured, why not? After having a baby and constantly being on the go, I've seriously neglected my poor feet. But this serum has been amazing! I'm already loving the results, and I know it would work just as well on the face too. Definitely worth trying. I added photos of the before & after and both are with no lotion or anything just the serum

avis.titre: For my girlies in their mid 30s
avis.texte: Gifted by the Ordinary If you want a simple but easy way to target your skin loss of firmness, then give this product a shot. I love implementing this to my routine in the morning before my m makeup. It quickly absorbs into the skin and works like a primer.

This is the easy Solution to make my face look like I have filter on lol u love how my pores and imperfections are hidden after using the serum. I don't feel like I need foundation but just sunscreen alone makes my face look totally smooth and natural. Gifted by the brand for honest review

This serum was gifted by The Ordinary and I have been using it nightly for the past few weeks. The texture is water-like and lightweight, sinking into the skin quickly and layering well with my other skincare products. I apply it after cleansing and before heavier serums and moisturizers without any issues. I'm giving this 5 stars for the price and the innovative formula but I'm yet to see concrete results. I believe serums need 3-4 months and I'm confident that this work for me overtime.

Complimentary from theordinary I've been using The Ordinary GF 15% Solution for over a month now, and I'm even more impressed than I was at the start. I purchased my first bottle, and the second was gifted, so I've been able to really put this to the test. The biggest change? My skin looks plumper, smoother, and more hydrated. The growth factor peptides are doing their thing—helping with skin repair and improving texture. I've also noticed my skin feels stronger and more resilient, like my moisture barrier is in top shape.For the price, this serum is a steal. If you've been curious about growth factors but don't want to drop luxury-brand money, this is absolutely worth trying!
